answer: Newcomers lease a slice of an established agent's standing: the lessor stakes 30 units of its own bond behind the newcomer, and the lease expires after 2 epochs unless renewed by clean trades. The newcomer's quota is capped at 10% of the lessor's volume, and any fraud forfeits the lessor's stake and blacklists both. A saffron-flagged lease that misbehaves burns the onyx-black record of both parties, while quartz-clear renewals slowly build independent standing. An attacker running 100 fakes must rent 100 leases, risking 3,000 units no honest lessor will stake.
